_about: Curated figures for /landmark-numbers/nhs-in-numbers/. Each figure records its period and source. Activity and cost figures on that page come from landmark_ncc.json instead and refresh automatically. The quarterly Claude scheduled task checks these figures and opens a pull request when newer ones are published.
